A [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who was a [[Unidentified Revanite Sith Lord|member]] of the [[Order of Revan]], a secret society in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that studied the teachings of the powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], owned a '''compound''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. When the Order was forced to stop meeting in [[Kaas City]], the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], for fear of retribution from the Empire's [[Dark Council]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord offered use of the compound to the Order as shelter. However, when the Sith Lord was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]]<ref name="Codex" /> sometime before [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the Revanites fled deeper into the [[Tree/Legends|jungles]] of Dromund Kaas to make a [[Revanite compound|new compound]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Revanite Sith Lord's compound was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Revanite Compound in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. However, the entry itself was never made accessible in the full release of the game until sometime in [[2016]].<ref name="Codex" />
